description: The Start window: what this computer is and whether it is signed in, "Open a video…" (the core's own open dialog; the Player plays what was picked), connecting in the browser (with a provider hint), and opening Lexpad's window once signed in. Dropped files reach the core's drag-and-drop event, not the page. Its own window: moved by its top edge, closed with Ctrl+W / ⌘W. Nothing else.
